name: PCCS Conference 2026
description: PVJ joined the Paediatric Critical Care Society community at Lord's in London for PCCS Conference 2026. We spoke with clinicians, nurses, allied health professionals, researchers, students and community partners about the ideas and experiences shaping paediatric critical care.

name: RCPCH Conference 2025
organiser: Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health
description: Interviews recorded at the Royal College of Paediatrics and Child Health annual conference in Glasgow, covering research, clinical practice, medicines safety, education and the voices of children and young people.

name: RCPCH Conference 2024
